opennyai_summary.facts:
Noticing non-appearance on behalf of the parties, the Court had issued notice to Respondent No.
2 through the concerned Investigating Officer on 3rd September, 2025.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: This indicates that the settlement relied upon by the Petitioners has not materialised.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
In light of the foregoing, the present petition is dismissed.
It is, however, clarified that the Court has not commented on the merits of the case.
In the event the parties reach a genuine settlement in future, they shall be at liberty to approach the Court through appropriate proceedings.
